findings.detail: The first poll after registering a source produced a candidate because the empty initial cursor looked like a change. R7 now records the first capture as a baseline and creates candidates only for changes after a real baseline.
findings.title: Monitor initial capture was treated as a change

findings.detail: Portfolio hashing included active monitor discoveries, so a selection re-run after restart could emit a new decision id. R7 hashes projects and candidate actions only, keeping restart selection idempotent.
findings.title: Selection restart hash drifted with later discoveries

findings.detail: The synthesis key was computed before capture using an empty content hash, so the second run built a different research id. R7 captures sources first and keys syntheses on the captured content hashes, making reruns idempotent.
findings.title: Research restart identity changed after first capture

findings.detail: One bounded read-only GitHub releases probe is attempted per research gate run. When the network is unavailable it is recorded BLOCKED and local real sources still drive the gate; no fake public evidence is ever recorded.
findings.title: Public research probe depends on network availability
